scripts.typecheck: s=0; for d in packages/* tools/*; do (cd "$d" && echo "[typecheck] $d" && ../../node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit) || s=1; done; exit $s
scripts.ci: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test && bun run lint:deps && bun run lint && bun run codegen:check && bun run schema:check
scripts.build: set -e; for d in $(node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const p=fs.readdirSync("packages").filter(d=>fs.existsSync(`packages/${d}/package.json`)&&require(`${process.cwd()}/packages/${d}/package.json`).scripts?.build);const leaf=["core","upcloud"];const m=p.filter(d=>!leaf.includes(d)&&d!=="cli").sort();console.log([...p.filter(d=>leaf.includes(d)).sort((a,b)=>leaf.indexOf(a)-leaf.indexOf(b)),...m,...p.filter(d=>d==="cli")].join(" "))'); do echo "[build] $d"; bun run --cwd "packages/$d" build; done
scripts.schema:check: set -e; cp kumulo.schema.json .kumulo.schema.check.bak; bun scripts/generate-schema.ts; s=0; diff -u .kumulo.schema.check.bak kumulo.schema.json || { s=$?; echo 'kumulo.schema.json is stale: run `bun run schema:generate` and commit'; }; mv .kumulo.schema.check.bak kumulo.schema.json; exit $s
